name: Rockwool A/S
summary: Established in 1909 and headquartered in Hedehusene, Denmark, Rockwool A/S is a prominent international manufacturer and distributor of stone wool insulation solutions. The company operates globally, with a significant presence across Western and Eastern Europe, North America, and Asia. Its operations are structured into two key divisions: Insulation and Systems. Rockwool offers a diverse portfolio of products under various brand names: ROCKWOOL provides fire-safe stone wool insulation; Rockfon specializes in acoustic solutions for ceilings and walls; Rockpanel supplies board materials for ventilated facade cladding, roof details, soffits, and fascia; Grodan focuses on stone wool growing media and technological support for the horticulture sector; and Lapinus delivers stone wool-based items for specialized uses including automotive, urban sound management, pre-fabricated residential construction, OEM applications, and urban climate adaptation initiatives. These versatile products find application across a wide spectrum of areas such as roofing, flooring, ceilings, interior and exterior walls, HVAC systems, acoustic treatments, industrial purposes, marine and offshore environments, basements, chimneys, sheds, garages, OEM integration, and passive fire protection, among others.
